title: Socioeconomic and biophysical characteristics of community households in the Bolivian Amazon
contributors: N. Ascarrunz (Instituto Boliviano de Investigación Forestal)
descriptions: I investigated the socio-ecological costs of the most commonly practiced multiple-use forest management by community-based families in the Bolivian Amazon. This database contains the most important socioeconomic and biophysical information of 24 community households belonging to 6 campesino communities.

Dataset includes a file describing the variables collected. Most variable values are on a yearly basis. There are only a couple of variable values that are for the last 5 years before data collection. In that case, the 5_years is indicated at the end of the variable name. The depositor provided the file 'Socio-ecological costs of ANTimber_4data depository' in XLSX format. DANS added the CSV formats of this file for preservation purposes. The depositor provided the files 'Research documentation_Socio-ecological costs of ANTimber' and 'Appendix 1' in DOCX format. DANS addded the PDF formats of these files.
